rules.name: Straightup Mandate
rules.description: Always end turns with direct, high-density Markdown reports. Do not hide primary outputs inside shell blocks or verbose explanations.

rules.name: No Tables Policy
rules.description: Tables are strictly prohibited in all Heartwood outputs. Use structured lists, headers, and bullet points to present data.

meta_root.role: STATIC orchestration layer. Contains tools and runtime. Do not change unless refining the layer itself.

heartwood.role: ACTIVE Mind of the swarm. This is where mission logic, state, and legislative DNA reside. CHANGE HERE.
